lines.deadlines_01: Got one! I've circled it twice already.
lines.deadlines_02: Tick tick, nothing scary, I just like saying it.
lines.deadlines_03: Filed with a little gold star. Neat, right?
lines.deadlines_04: A date! I love a date. Not that kind, the calendar kind.
lines.deadlines_05: Don't worry, I've got the clock on this one.
lines.deadlines_06: I set three imaginary alarms. You only need one.
lines.deadlines_07: This one's tucked in nice and tidy under my arm.

deadlines.note: keys deadlines_01..08 are playful; deadlines_s01, deadlines_s02 are serious and used for importance 4-5 or items due today/tomorrow

lines.chats_02: Saved the chat. I didn't read it. Much.
lines.chats_03: Plans! I love plans. Who's coming?
lines.chats_05: I heard nothing. I know everything. That's the deal.
lines.chats_06: A good one. I'll keep it between us.
lines.chats_08: Look at all that chatter. Perfect for my collection.

lines.chats_s02: There's a plan in this chat for tomorrow. Tap to see it.

lines.money_02: Rounded up, added up, put away.
lines.money_03: Ooh, a price. Let me write that down.
lines.money_04: Neat and tidy, just how I like my numbers.
lines.money_05: Tickets, bills, bargains. I've got it all in one pocket.
lines.money_06: I tucked this one in the good drawer.
lines.money_07: I counted it twice. Once for luck.
lines.money_08: Saved it so the numbers stay in one place.

lines.ideas_02: I'll keep this one safe for later.
lines.ideas_03: What a lovely thing to save for later.

lines.ideas_06: This one made me daydream a little.

priming.title: Can we look at your screenshots?
priming.body: The app reads only your Screenshots album. Images are sent securely to be read, and you can delete everything anytime in Settings.

lines.priming_01: Just the screenshots, never the rest of your photos.
lines.priming_02: I'm ready to sort them into rooms for you.
lines.priming_03: One tap and I'll start reading.
